prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 50.7 °C (64% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 55.8 °C (55% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 57.3 °C (47% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.69 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.47 s (2% above healthy). Minor delay in pressure rise and slight inter-sensor switching lag indicate beginning valve actuation lag.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 4.30 l/min (35% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 594 W·min/l (55% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 39.0 % (33% below healthy). High power-to-flow ratio demonstrates extensive internal leakage across the pump chambers.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 53.9 bar (15% above healthy). Slight increase in pressure oscillations indicates reduced surge dampening capacity.
